programs.title: UFO: POV
programs.desc: Renowned UFO expert Chris Rutkowski investigates real unexplained encounters, combining eyewitness testimony, on-the-ground investigation, and decades of research to uncover what really happened.

programs.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programs.desc: The human remains of a woman are found near Vejle, Denmark; an archaeologist begins to tell a story about who she was and why she was murdered, connecting her to ancient fairy tales and even King Harald Bluetooth.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: The investigation at the historic Rosedeer Hotel & Last Chance Saloon gets underway; Jordyn is attacked by a force that obviously does not want them there; undeterred, Johnny and Jordyn explore the hotel.

programs.title: Revolutions That Changed History
programs.desc: After years of fighting arm-in-arm with their British compatriots, American colonists are shocked by stern import duties enacted over the heads of the colonies.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: Explorers uncover one of the largest Incan burial sites at Ancon on the Peruvian coast; it may be proof that the Chacoans were a matriarchal society.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: What happens when humanity does not prepare for the worst that Mother Nature can unleash, and how people can better prepare for the disasters of the future.
